assurance_contract.scope: Source-pinned pressure test of VTI session versus HTTPS refusal preservation, step-up binding, replay and non-authorizing failure semantics.
assurance_contract.non_scope: No claim of deployment conformance, independently executed consuming-path tests, privacy specialist determination or production-authority cutover.
assurance_propositions: An upstream Trust Task refusal, including its typed document and stepUpHandoff, must survive session and HTTPS transport boundaries without becoming successful authorization.
A step-up continuation must be bound to the original authorized principal, purpose, operation, context and validity and reject replay, ambiguity or substitution.
scenarios: generic session error with missing refused document
wrong-target purpose or principal during step-up
stale or replayed step-up across transports
successful response distinguished from refusal and next-step
harms: implicit authorization from dropped error metadata

actions.action: Obtain source-pinned consuming-path traces for session/TSP and HTTPS positive and negative cases, including authenticated step-up expiry and target binding.
actions.acceptance_criterion: VTI-0001-R1 and VTI-0001-R2 have attributable positive and adversarial evidence before any assurance determination is imported.
